_comment: Single source of truth for shot types. validate.py reads this; each engine/shots/<name>.js must register a shot with the same name and honour these params. 'words' fields are on-screen text and must be <= 5 words each.

title.purpose: Hero line reveal. A light sweep passes behind big centred text, glow swells, slow push-in. Best opener or closer of an idea.

sub.note: small secondary line under the title

type.purpose: Text types on character by character; the last character typed flashes white then cools to the beat colour. With bar=true it sits in a dark glass search/prompt bar with a caret and a leading icon.

number.purpose: A concrete figure slams in (scale overshoot) with a bloom flash and a shockwave ring; optional count-up; short label below.

value.note: e.g. '40%', '9s', '10x', '$0', '1M+'. Not word-limited but keep <= 6 characters

countUp.note: counts up the numeric part when the value has one

tiles.purpose: A grid of dark matte glass icon tiles; they light up one after another (rim light + icon glow), optional caption.

icons.note: 3-6 icon names from the core icon set

labels.note: one short label per tile (<= 2 words recommended)

rings.purpose: A glass orb pulses; concentric rings expand outward in waves with a shockwave on the downbeat; a line of text sits over/under it.

device.purpose: A dark glass device (phone, window or card) with rim light, slow push-in; simple glowing UI inside (calendar grid, list rows, bar chart, chat bubbles or code lines). Caption outside the device.

kind.note: auto = phone in 9:16, window in 16:9, card in 1:1

orbit.purpose: A glowing core with glass chips orbiting it on tilted elliptical paths (integrations, platforms, partners). Chips carry short names.

stack.purpose: 2-3 short lines arrive one after another on hard light hits, each lighting up then settling; earlier lines dim slightly. For short lists of benefits.

endcard.purpose: Logo lockup: brand wordmark (or embedded logo image) with a glass glyph and light bloom, call to action and URL. Always the last beat.

cut.note: flash = 2-frame white-hot flash at the start of the beat

hero.note: beat uses the brand colour instead of its place on the spectrum arc

note.note: free text for humans; not rendered
